title: Trellis view: compact per-model & per-route performance canvas
creator: Asha Menon
description: Purpose: design a compact, scannable Trellis-style canvas for per-model and per-route performance that fits within the Console's endpoint view and onboarding dashboard. The Trellis should surface latency distributions (P50/P95/P99), throughput (rps), token flow (input vs generated tokens), and cost attribution in a single compact row per route/model. Goals: 1) enable rapid triage of regressions across tens of routes; 2) make cost vs latency trade-offs visible at glance; 3) support quick drill into microtraces and query examples. Constraints: must render cleanly at widths from 320px to 1440px, adhere to Console design tokens, and be performant in React with virtualized lists. This ticket covers wireframes, high-fidelity charts spec, prototype frames, developer handoff notes, and initial review feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Canvas renders as a compact horizontal Trellis with one row per route/model and up to 6 micro-widgets: status, P50 sparkline, P95 violin compact, P99 badge, throughput sparkline, token-cost mini-waterfall.
Each micro-widget supports hover tooltip with exact metrics and links to the traces/requests that contributed to the window.
Chart specs include slot allocations, color palette, min/max heights, and simplified aggregation rules for streaming vs non-streaming models.
Prototype in Figma clickable through: global filter (time window, region, model family), search to highlight routes, and drill-to-route detail panel.
Design handoff includes a component mapping document for frontend: data props, accessibility labels, and recommended sampling thresholds for rendering live data.
PM/Eng sign-off recorded in comments and a follow-up ENG ticket created for telemetry hooks and sampling.
Responsive behavior validated for narrow and wide layouts; mobile collapses to two stacked metrics (latency + cost) with quick toggles.
Automated visual spec added to design QA checklist: token-sparkline must not exceed 3px stroke width and violins must render with 80% opacity fill for P95 band.
Performance budget target: render 200 rows in under 1200ms in a dev environment with mocked telemetry (React + virtualization).
design_decisions: Use Trellis rows instead of full cards to enable multi-row scanning for SRE and platform teams.
Show P50 and P95 as sparklines and reserve a small violin/mini-heat for P99 to keep visual weight low.
Combine token inputs/generation into a stacked mini-waterfall to surface cost drivers without a separate chart panel.
Adopt a single color family per model (hues with light/dark variants) and grayscale for routes without model affinity.
Avoid dense legends per row; instead provide a global legend anchored in header with contextual mode toggles.
Favor deterministic rendering for sampling: initial render uses 5s sampling window, hovering triggers live re-query for exact values.
review_feedback: PM (R. Patel): looks good for initial scope; please add a clear CTA to open route rollout history from the row.
Eng (S. Rivera): prefer fewer heavyweight violins; propose replacing P99 violin with a compact numeric spark-badge to reduce DOM complexity.
SRE (M. Chen): add colorblind-safe palette and ensure hover tooltips are reachable on keyboard navigation.
Design (J. Alvarez): reduce label density by collapsing secondary labels into a kebab menu on hover for long route names.
Product Ops (K. Ito): request an export CSV action that respects current filters and shows token/cost per-route for billing reconciliation.
iterations: 2025-02-10: initial wireframes (compact + expanded) uploaded to Figma and shared with PM/Eng.
2025-02-12: refined micro-widget spacing and introduced stacked token-waterfall to replace a full token chart.
2025-02-15: eng review suggested replacing violin with numeric P99 badge; updated mockups and added hover drill to microtrace.
2025-02-18: created high-fidelity responsive frames and started developer handoff doc; ticket moved to In Review.
Next: schedule cross-functional design review session, finalize handoff, and open ENG-51290 for telemetry hooks.
acceptance_test_steps: Open prototyped Trellis at /console/endpoints and apply time filter (1h, 6h, 24h): verify sparklines update.
Search for a route with > 10k rps in mock data: confirm throughput sparkline and token-waterfall reflect the high load.
Keyboard navigate through rows: confirm focus states and tooltips are accessible and readable by screen readers.
Hover P50/P95 sparkline: verify tooltip shows exact numeric values and a link 'Open request sample' that opens trace panel.
Toggle cost overlay: ensure per-row cost numbers recompute and total cost in header updates accordingly.
notes_for_engineering: Data contract: each row expects pre-aggregated metrics: p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, rps, tokens_in_avg, tokens_out_avg, cost_per_minute.
Recommend frontend sampling: initial passive samples at 5s cadence; on-hover, fetch exact bucketed traces with a separate trace endpoint.
Rendering: implement virtualization for large route lists and canvas-based sparklines for low DOM count.
Accessibility: expose ARIA labels for each micro-widget and ensure color contrast matches AA for text elements.
